acceptance: Overlap reruns, fix reruns and final evidence record ran_command and the dropped paths.
A rerun whose recorded test paths are all gone fails closed without running pytest.
A member-owned deleted path still fails evidence (existing test passes).
description:
PR #4020 (fix/batch-rerun-deleted-test-paths, from another session) and PR #4027 both fixed batch evidence for receipt test paths deleted by develop. #4020 drops any pytest path absent from the checkout. #4027 drops a path only when a recorded develop merge deleted it and no member owns it. Merged together they turned develop red: two #4027 tests failed, because #4020's broader dropping lets a member-owned deleted path pass. The owner chose to revert #4020 (revert PR #4038).

Worth keeping from #4020: rerun entries and final evidence rows keep `command` as recorded and add `ran_command` and the dropped paths; overlap and fix reruns (not only final evidence) also drop such paths; and the rerun fails closed without running pytest when every recorded test path is gone.

Change. Re-add those behaviours within #4027's rule (only paths deleted by a recorded develop merge and not member-owned). Batch tooling ships serially.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; no explanatory comments; keep test_evidence_still_fails_for_a_test_path_a_member_owns and the pr_landing dropped-path checks passing.
